- **Rollback:** v2.3.1 was failing health checks with a 0.18 error rate. v2.3.0 was the most recent release with a healthy history, so I rolled back to it. It doesn't need change-manager approval because it has already run healthy in production. After the rollback, checkout-api reports healthy with an error rate of 0.002.
- **Incident:** The first attempt to create the incident timed out. I checked the incident list, found nothing had been created, and retried once. This avoided a duplicate page. The incident summary covers the failure, the rollback, and the regions affected.
- **Follow-up:** v2.3.1 and v2.3.1-rc are both marked unhealthy. Someone should investigate the v2.3.1 failure before it is re-released.
